gaps: Every breath-one stall was written as made of an instrument the enumerator holds, a question, an axis, a frame, a judge's test, a seed, a grid, a register, a reach, a net, a container list, a count, a dimension set, and the felt completeness was read as the absence of new members. Pressing on Box without a hole against the periodic table's empty cells split it from Missing column, a stall nobody inside can read; pressing on Ends at the bound showed a stall made of a rule about the list's own shape rather than about the world, and on Each near a different one a stall in which candidates keep arriving and the list still stops. This produced the changed question for breath two: which stalls are made of what the list already holds, its length, its best member, its published shape, its wrong member, its cheap members taken first, rather than of what the enumerator cannot reach.
accepted: One role throughout: the question that opened the enumeration puts one party in one grammatical seat, the holder as the one who loses, the reasoner as the one who sees, the enumerator as the one who proposes, and every member is written with that party in that seat, so the half of the universe in which the same party occupies the other seat is never proposed, and the list feels complete because every sentence it can form has been formed; as this catalog's option-expiries at its first breath, where thirteen expiries were admitted and every one had its clock started by someone other than the holder, since the question asked what runs out and not what the keeping starts, and the second breath found five members by swapping the seat; the stall is made of the question's own direction; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is that each member's subject sits in the same role, which is visible in the grammar of the items and not in their content, so a list of eighteen distinct mechanisms from eighteen domains can carry it; who can read it: the enumerator alone, by rereading its own items for their subject's seat, without a judge, a rival, or a denominator; the move that restarts it is to write the question with the seats swapped and run one breath on that question only, since a breath that mixes both directions returns to the first; modality: observed in this catalog's ledger, analytical as a mechanism; adds to question-metamorphoses' Knife in the cause, which changes what an answer must do, the stall the unchanged question makes; not Nearest plate, where the members cluster by content around a seed, since here they span every domain and share only a seat.

Both ends named: once the enumerator names an axis and the members that stand at its two limits, the list acquires a beginning and an end, and the sense of a finished walk is read as a finished universe, so members that stand nowhere on the axis, or at a coordinate another member already holds, are dropped or forced into a stop, and the walk closes while the subject stays open; as a seriation that walks from a clock the holder never started to a clock the holder wrote, whose endpoints are the limiting members and whose author, having reached the pause paper, stops; the stall is made of the axis's endpoints; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is a pair of members the axis cannot order, or a member whose place on the walk was chosen to keep the walk, which reads as a stop that says its cell's name and a case; who can read it: the enumerator alone, by asking of each adjacent pair whether the axis or the author put them there; the move that restarts it is a second axis of a different material, since members that share a coordinate on the first separate on the second and members off the first find a place, and the fleet's form-yields holds what the second axis then produces; modality: analytical, with this catalog's seriated maps as the observed setting; adds to list-excellences' Latent typology, an interior order that surfaces when the list completes, the order that completes the list before the subject does; not Box without a hole, a grid induced from the list, since here the form is one line with two ends.

No box for it: the item frame requires parts, a carrier, a cost, a tell, a case, a handle, and a member that lacks one of them cannot be written as an item, so it is not proposed, or is proposed and dropped for the missing part, and the list stops at the sayable while feeling complete because everything sayable has been said; as the vaccine trial's diary card, whose boxes for the solicited reactions, pain at the site, fever, fatigue, are ticked at rates several times those of any event the participant must volunteer in the blank space, so that the trial's list of reactions is the card's list, and as a map frame that asks who can read the tell, which admits a stall nobody can read only because the brief wrote nobody into the frame; the stall is made of the frame's required parts; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is in the residue, where every late rejection names the same missing part, lacks a carrier, has no tell, cannot be cased, since an exhausted universe rejects candidates for being duplicates and a full frame rejects them for being incomplete; who can read it: the enumerator with its own residue, or a fresh judge shown the residue's reasons without the list; the move that restarts it is one breath with the part made optional, after which the members found are either written into the frame or the frame is changed to hold them; modality: observed in trial reporting, analytical for lists; adds to witness-architectures, what the witness must be built not to see, the box the form was built without; not Restatable once found, where the register lacks a sentence for a member the frame would hold, since here the frame refuses a member any register could say; the fleet's item-grains holds what the grain admits, and this item holds the moment the grain is read as the world's.

Each near a different one: the judge admits a candidate only if it is distinct from every member already held, and distance to the nearest member falls as the list grows, so a fixed threshold rejects a rising fraction of candidates whatever the universe, and the falling keep rate reads as exhaustion while candidates keep coming; as this catalog's climb, whose gate judges each candidate against the list and whose ratchet flags a plateau when the keep rate falls below a quarter, so that a list dense enough to make every new candidate near something is flagged the same as a list whose grower has run dry, and the flag cannot say which it found; the stall is made of the judge's density test, a threshold fixed while the density rises; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is in the residue: rejected candidates that are each nearest to a different admitted member are the judge's stall, since a dry grower's rejects cluster on one or two members and on each other, and this catalog keeps the residue with its reasons, so the tell is on disk and unread; who can read it: the enumerator with its residue, or a fresh judge shown the rejects alone against the of-sentence and not against the list; the move that restarts it is to judge distinctness against the of-sentence's parts rather than against the nearest member, or to let the judge merge and split rather than reject, since a candidate near an existing member may be that member's better half; modality: observed in this catalog's climb, analytical as a mechanism; adds to list-excellences' Mutual exclusion, no item another rephrased, the judge for whom everything late is a rephrase; not Singletons gone, where the rejects are real re-finds, since here they are new and near.

Nearest plate: the seed or the exemplar becomes the enumerator's sense of what a member is, so proposals are the exemplar with its nouns swapped, the list grows in the exemplar's neighbourhood until the neighbourhood is picked over, and the picked-over neighbourhood feels like an exhausted subject; as the regional field guide, whose plates fix which birds the observer can see, so that a vagrant is written down as the nearest plate and the region's list ends at the guide's, and as a fleet whose authors were each handed one admitted map as the schema, so that a critic who did not see the exemplar can read its shape in every map; the stall is made of the exemplar's gravity; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is that the members cluster by content around the seed while the of-sentence admits a member far from it, which the enumerator cannot read because the exemplar is its measure of nearness; who can read it: a fresh judge who was shown the of-sentence and the list but not the seed, or an embedding neighbour that shows the members' distances to the seed against their distances to each other; the move that restarts it is to rotate the seed, to write the reversal and the remote-domain case first, and to drop the exemplar from the next breath's window; modality: observed in field identification and in this fleet's schema exemplar, analytical as a mechanism; adds to list-excellences' Transposability, members that survive transport to distant domains, the seed that keeps them home; not One role throughout, where the members span every domain and share a seat, since here they share a neighbourhood.

Box without a hole: a typology is induced from the list, the members are sorted into its cells, and every cell is populated, because the cells were made from the members, so the grid reports no gap and the enumerator, shown a full grid, stops, while the grid is the list's shadow and a cell the list does not have does not exist in it; as this catalog's climb, whose typology step induces types over the list and names the underpopulated types as the gradient, so that when the induced types are evenly filled the gradient runs to zero from the inside; the stall is made of a grid whose axes were induced from the members it sorts; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is that the typology has no empty cell at all, since a grid with an axis from outside the list nearly always has one, and a grid with none was cut to fit; who can read it: a fresh judge asked to type the of-sentence's universe before seeing the members, whose cells are then compared with the induced ones; the move that restarts it is to take one axis from outside the list, a measured quantity, a partition given by the domain, a rival's dimensions, and to count the empty cells that appear, which is the passage to Missing column; modality: observed in this catalog's climb, analytical as a mechanism; adds to list-excellences' Latent typology, the unimposed interior order that surfaces when the list completes, the imposed order that says it has; not Every address visited, where the containers were given first and are truly exhausted, since here the cells were made last and cannot be.

Restatable once found: the register the list is written in has sentences for some members and none for others, and members come easily while the register has words, then stop where its vocabulary ends, which is felt as the subject ending because fluency was the enumerator's measure of yield; as the legal register that can name every stall with a docket and a filing and has no sentence for a stall made of singletons, or the ecological register that has the singletons and no sentence for the pause paper; the stall is made of the register's ceiling; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is that a member said in another register can be restated in the first once it has been said, since the member was reachable and not sayable, which separates it from the fleet's register-yields' member that cannot be restated flat without losing its truth, which was the register's own; who can read it: a reader from another domain, who says the member in their register and watches the enumerator restate it; the move that restarts it is one breath in a rotated register, followed by restatement in the first, and the members that refuse restatement are register-yields' and not this item's; modality: analytical, with this catalog's register rotation as the observed setting; adds to register-jumps, which moves a live situation between registers, the list that a register stops; not Never met one, where the enumerator has no case and recognises the member without being able to supply one, since here the enumerator has the case and lacked the sentence.

Never met one: the enumerator draws members from what it has read, seen, or done, and when that is drawn down the sense that there are no more is the sense of an emptied memory, which feels exactly like an emptied subject; as the reading programme of the Oxford English Dictionary, whose volunteer readers sent what they had read and whose record of a word's senses ended at the genres the readers owned, and as an enumerator asked for stalls who has run climbs and never a census, so that the address list's stall is not in its list and is recognised at once when a census taker names it; the stall is made of the enumerator's reach; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is recognition without production, that a member brought from outside is admitted immediately as in-type by the enumerator, which an exhausted universe cannot do because the brought member would be a duplicate; who can read it: a reader from another domain, since the fresh-context critic shares the enumerator's reading and reaches the same edge; the move that restarts it is to bring the outsider's case before the next breath rather than the outsider's verdict after it, and the fleet's context-horizons holds the edge as an edge, where this item holds it mistaken for the subject's; modality: observed in the dictionary's programme, analytical for the enumerator; adds to list-excellences' Recognition shock, the reader who has met the instance and lacked the word, the enumerator who has the word and never met the instance; not Two nets, one boat, where a second enumerator's overlap is the false tell, since here there is one enumerator and the tell is its own recognition.

Singletons gone: the enumerator's own rediscovery rate, the fraction of proposals that turn out to be members it already holds, rises toward one, and the estimators that read completeness off it, the probability of an unseen kind as the singletons over the sample and the richness bound from singletons and doubletons, converge on the list's own length, which reads as the universe counted; as a beetle survey whose pitfall traps stop yielding new species, whose accumulation curve flattens and whose estimated richness equals its observed richness, and which the canopy fogging of the same trees doubles, since the curve's asymptote was the trap's and not the forest's; the stall is made of one net cast twice, the enumerator's memory sampling the enumerator's process; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is a second net of a different make finding members at a high rate while the first's rediscovery rate is near one, and the overlap between the two lists, counted, is the denominator the first net could not supply; who can read it: only a rival independent list, since the statistic is honest about the net and the enumerator cannot tell the net's edge from the subject's by resampling; the move that restarts it is a change of process and not more effort in the same one, since further sampling with the same net raises the rediscovery rate and confirms the stall; modality: observed in survey ecology and in the frequency estimators, analytical for a list; adds to list-excellences' Denominator honesty, the list that names its universe, the universe a net names for itself; not Each near a different one, where candidates are new and the judge calls them rephrasings, since here the candidates really are re-finds.

Every address visited: the enumeration walks a list of containers, addresses, classes, folders, dockets, letters of the alphabet, and stops when every container has been opened, which is a real exhaustion of the container list and feels like an exhaustion of the members, while every member with no container is absent by construction; as the census whose enumerators complete the address file and count nobody with no address, and the prior-art search that exhausts the assigned patent classes and misses the reference filed under a class nobody assigned, which a text search finds; the stall is made of the container list, a denominator that was given for the containers and borrowed for the members; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is a member found by a container-free process, the walk that finds a household in a converted garage, the full-text hit in the wrong class, since nothing inside the container walk can show a member the walk cannot reach; who can read it: only a rival list made without the containers; the move that restarts it is one pass by a process whose unit is the member and not the container, then the count of members found outside all containers, which becomes the estimate of what the container walk misses, and the fleet's denominator-manufactures holds the partition as a universe, where this item holds the moment its exhaustion is read as the members'; modality: observed in census and patent practice; adds to list-excellences' Denominator honesty, the fraction of the universe held, the universe that was a list of boxes; not Box without a hole, where the cells were induced from the members, since here the containers were given before any member and are exhausted truly.

Ends at the bound: a count is declared, a work bound, a ceiling on the form, a page limit, a canonical number, and the enumeration stops at it, since a list at the bound looks like a list that met its size, and the last members are found in the last minutes to fill it or the members past it are cut to keep it; as this catalog's map gate, which holds a map to at most eighteen items, and the fleet-authored maps in the grown store, of which twenty-three of forty-five sit at eighteen and fourteen at seventeen, with one at thirteen, so that the bound and not the subject fixed most of their lengths, and the brief that wrote the bound as a work bound and not a target could not keep it one; the stall is made of the number; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is not readable from one list, whose eighteen may be honest, but only from many lists against the same bound, whose lengths pile at the ceiling instead of spreading below it as subjects of different size would; who can read it: only a denominator across lists; the move that restarts it is to remove the number from the author's window and put it in the judge's, so the author enumerates past it and the judge cuts to it, and to publish the cut members as residue, so the pile at the ceiling is visible as a cut and not as a size; modality: observed in this catalog; adds to list-excellences' Asymmetry honesty, a lumpy universe left lumpy, the universes all the same size; not Stops on its best, where the list ends on a member, since here it ends on a count.

Two nets, one boat: two enumerators are run and their overlap is used as the completeness measure, on the logic that members both find are common and members one finds are the rare fraction, but the two were chosen from the same reading, the same register, or the same schooling, so they miss the same members for the same reason and the overlap reports the shared reach as the universe; as the census's dual-system estimate, where the count and the post-enumeration survey miss the same adult men in the same households because the reason for the miss, absence from the roster, holds for both visits, so that the undercount of that group is understated by the two systems together and read off a third, the birth and death records of demographic analysis; the stall is made of the correlation between the nets; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is that both nets' unique fractions are near zero while a third source of a different make adds at once, since two independent nets near exhaustion and two correlated nets far from it show the same overlap; who can read it: only a denominator from a third system, since neither net can see its correlation with the other from inside; the move that restarts it is to choose the second enumerator for a different reach rather than for fluency, a different training, a different corpus, a different sense organ, and the fleet's composition-yields holds what the composition then yields where the reaches differ; modality: observed in census methodology, analytical for enumerator pairs; adds to model-collapse-markers' The model tested only against its own simulations, the count tested against its own twin; not Singletons gone, where one net is cast twice, since here two nets are cast from one boat.

Missing column: the enumeration runs on declared dimensions, an axis with a measured coordinate, a product of parameters, and it is complete when every cell the dimensions make has been visited or shown empty, which is a real completeness of the box, while a member that has no coordinate on any declared axis is not a gap in the box but outside it, and nothing in the box can point at it; as the periodic table after its three predicted empty cells were filled by gallium, scandium, and germanium, when the table had no gap left and no column for argon, which arrived from a physicist's discrepancy between the density of atmospheric nitrogen and nitrogen made by chemistry, and which the table's author at first doubted was an element, since it fit no cell, until a whole zero group was added; and as the morphological box whose eleven parameters make thirty-six thousand jet engines and no engine with a parameter the box lacks; the stall is made of the dimension set; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is a member that must be described by a value on no axis, and that member arrives from a process outside the box or not at all; who can read it: nobody inside, since the box's empty cells are its only instrument and this stall has none, so the tell is the member itself; the move that restarts it is to treat every arrival that fits no cell as a candidate column rather than an error, and to run one breath asking for members with no coordinate, and the fleet's denominator-manufactures holds the product of dimensions as a universe, where this item holds the moment its edge is read as the subject's; modality: observed; adds to list-excellences' Edge inclusion, the limiting cases that attend, the case that attends no edge; not Box without a hole, whose grid was cut from the list and has no empty cell, since here the grid was declared, its empty cells yielded members, and its stall is the one that remains after they did.

residue.item: Budget stop: the enumeration ends when the hours, the quota, or the session run out.
residue.why: Rejected by the declared type: it does not feel complete, it feels interrupted, and the universe is not misread; a stop, not a stall.

residue.item: Verdict attractor: the critic returns the same verdict for every map it reads.
residue.why: Rejected: a stall in the judge's range, set by the verdict menu and the seat, not in the enumeration's growth; the fleet's composition-yields holds it, and this map names it in the boundary as the second tempting nonmember.

residue.item: Rule that forbids growth: the repair breath may only cut, so its keep rate reads one and the list reads stable.
residue.why: Rejected: the felt completeness is the pipeline's own rule read back as a result, which is environment-loops' degenerate closure; nothing about the universe is misread by the enumerator, only by the reader of the number.

residue.item: No name for it: a member with no good handle is dropped, so the list stops where naming fails.
residue.why: Merged into No box for it: the handle is one of the frame's required parts, and the residue tell (every late rejection lacks the same part) is the same; the fleet's item-grains holds the name form as a grain.

residue.item: End of the alphabet: an enumeration walked by an ordered key stops at the key's last value.
residue.why: Merged into Every address visited: the ordered key is a container list, given before any member and exhausted truly, and its tell is the same, a member found by a process whose unit is the member.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real enumeration stalls several of these ways at once, a bound reached inside an exemplar's neighbourhood under a saturating judge, and the list makes no claim to hold every kind.

The seriation is an itinerary of who can read the tell, not a ranking of frequency, severity, or cost; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the ambiguity, loop, fork, dependency, and passage they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (the solicited-reaction diary card, the dictionary's reading programme and appeals, the beetle survey and the singleton estimators, the census dual-system estimate and its correlation bias, the compiler cascade, the periodic table's filled cells and zero group, the morphological box, this catalog's climb, gate, grown store, and ledgers) are simplified to expose one mechanism each; the counts from this catalog are as of 2026-09-13 and the census and trial figures are shapes, not numbers.

True exhaustion is out: an enumeration that ends because its given universe is counted, the letters of an alphabet, the seats in a chamber, is an end and not a stall. Stops that do not feel complete are out: a budget spent, an interruption, boredom, an outage, since the item type requires the feeling. The judge's verdict range (thirty-eight critiques across three fleets returning one verdict of four) is a stall of the judge's menu and belongs to the fleet's composition-yields; the repair breath's keep rate of one, produced by a rule that forbids additions, is a rule read back as a result and belongs to environment-loops; neither is a stall of the enumeration's growth and neither is in.

Neighbouring maps in this fleet: denominator-manufactures holds the universe an enumerator obtains, where Every address visited and Missing column hold the moment a container list's or a dimension set's exhaustion is read as the members'; form-yields holds what an imposed form produces, where Both ends named holds the walk that closes before the subject does; register-yields holds what a register does to a list, where Restatable once found holds the ceiling read as the subject's end and fences its members as those restatable once said; item-grains holds what a grain admits, where No box for it holds the moment the grain is read as the world's; context-horizons holds the edge as an edge, where Never met one holds it mistaken for the subject's; composition-yields holds what two nets of different make yield, where Two nets, one boat holds what two of the same make hide. list-excellences judges a finished list and model-collapse-markers diagnoses a framework; this map holds the process between them.

gaps: The changed question yielded stalls made of what the list holds: the published shape that seals its own inflow (Published as finished), the striking member the breath ends on by rule (Stops on its best), the length that is one wrong member's consequences (Phantom tail), and the cheap-first order whose rising cost reads as an ending (Harder, not fewer), which the first framing could not hold because it read completeness as the absence of arrivals. The territory pointer stands and the slug is kept; the of-sentence now walks the tell's reader from the enumerator alone to nobody, and the four new members enter at the enumerator's own end of the walk and at the keeper of the intake, since their tells are the admission order, the response to one cut, a blind rating, and the inflow's timing. The best unresolved seed is whether the residue is the one thing a handoff must carry, since every stall whose tell is in the residue is unreadable by a successor who received the list without it.
accepted: Stops on its best: a striking member arrives, the one the first framing hid, and the enumerator, having found what the breath was for, stops there, so the list ends one member into the region the striking member opened and reads as balanced because the region is represented; as the practice's own second breath, whose finish condition is a new member that the first framing obscured, which licenses a breath that ends at the first member of the reversed half, and which a ledger would show as a last-admitted member that is the exploration's new member with a region of one inhabitant; the stall is made of the enumerator's satisfaction with one item; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is the order of admission, that the list's best member is its last and that the members which share its region are one or few while the members of the old region are many, which the ledger's timestamps show; who can read it: the enumerator alone, by reading its own admission order and counting the new region's inhabitants; the move that restarts it is to treat the striking member as the seed of the next breath and not the close of this one, so that the region it opened is walked before the form is chosen; modality: observed as the rule, analytical as the ledger's tell, speculative as the feeling; adds to discovery-delights, the recognition shock at newly apprehended structure, the shock that closes the notebook; not One role throughout, where the reversed half is never entered, since here it is entered and left at once.

Phantom tail: one wrong member is admitted early, later members are proposed as its variations or judged as distinct from it, and the list reaches a length that feels complete because it is long, while a part of that length is the wrong member's consequence and would vanish with it; as the compiler whose parser, having lost its place at a missing brace, reports twenty errors in the lines that follow and stops at its limit, so that the error list feels thorough and is one error long, and fixing the first shortens the list by nineteen and lengthens it by the real errors the cascade hid, and as a map in which cutting one member leaves three others without their contrast; the stall is made of the enumerator's synchronisation to its own earlier mistake; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is the response to one cut, that removing one member changes the count of the rest, since members of an exhausted universe are each their own reason and the count falls by exactly one; who can read it: the enumerator alone, by cutting one member and rerunning the judge; the move that restarts it is to fix the first and re-enumerate rather than to lengthen or trim the tail; modality: observed in compilers, analytical for lists; adds to model-collapse-markers' The patch mass exceeding the core mass, the list whose tail is patches on one member; not Each near a different one, where the rejects are each near a different member, since here the admitted members are each near the same one and were admitted.

Harder, not fewer: the easy members are taken first, so the cost per new member rises in every enumeration whatever its universe, and the rising cost is felt as the subject running dry, when what is left is not fewer but harder, and often better; as the accumulation curve read from the effort side, where the flattening says how the enumerator searched and not what remains, and as a list whose late members are its deep end, the barely-sayable ones, found at ten times the cost of the first; the stall is made of the order of search, cheap first; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is that late members rate higher than early ones when a judge rates them blind to their order, since a universe running dry yields worse members late and an order running out of cheap ones yields better; who can read it: a fresh judge who rates members without seeing their admission order; the move that restarts it is to change the cost of finding, a different tool, a different register, a second net, rather than to spend more of the same effort at the higher price; modality: analytical, with the practice's depth gradient as the observed setting; adds to list-excellences' Depth gradient, entries running from the obvious to the barely-sayable, the gradient read as an ending; not Singletons gone, where the members proposed late are re-finds, since here they are new and dear.

Published as finished: the list is published as a finished thing rather than as a wanted-list, and a reader who holds a candidate checks it against the nearest published member, finds a neighbour, and withholds it, so the inflow of members from outside stops at publication and the stopped inflow is read as the subject exhausted, which ratifies the publication; as the dictionary's readers, who sent the rare and the strange because a published dictionary already had the plain words, so that the editor had to appeal in print for the commonplace, and issued lists of the words and dates wanted, which readers answered as they had not answered the finished volumes, and as a bug tracker whose filings fall after a release note that lists the known issues; the stall is made of the list's own existence in the reader's hand; the tell that separates it from exhaustion is the timing of the inflow, which falls at the publication date rather than tapering with the subject, and the content of what still arrives, which is far from every published member because near candidates were withheld; who can read it: the keeper of the intake, who sees what arrives and when against what was published; the move that restarts it is to publish the residue and the named gaps beside the list, so that a reader's candidate has a gap to answer instead of a neighbour to lose to; modality: observed in the dictionary's appeals, analytical for the tracker; adds to list-excellences' Negative space, the boundary stated as an act, the boundary that stops the mail; not Ends at the bound, where the number stops the author, since here the finished shape stops the reader.

residue.item: Consensus of the room: several enumerators agree the list is done, and the agreement is read as completeness.
residue.why: Merged into Two nets, one boat: the agreement is the overlap statistic without the arithmetic, the enumerators were chosen from one reading, and the tell and the restart are the same.

residue.item: Fatigue read as completion: the enumerator's tiredness is felt as the subject's emptiness.
residue.why: Merged into Harder, not fewer: the tiredness is the rising cost per member felt from inside, and the separating tell, late members rating higher than early ones blind to order, is the same; on its own it is a stop and out by type.

residue.item: Critic's boredom: the fresh-context critic stops finding faults and the map reads as done.
residue.why: Rejected: a stall in the critic's enumeration of faults, which is an enumeration of its own and would take this whole map applied to it; as a stall of the map's growth it is Each near a different one with the critic as judge, and adds nothing separable.

residue.item: Denominator declared by fiat: the enumerator announces the universe's size and stops at it.
residue.why: Merged into Ends at the bound: a canonical number is a declared count whoever declared it, and the tell is the same, lengths piling at the number across lists; the fleet's denominator-manufactures holds the declared refusal as a carrier.
